title: Civil Works Project Officer
content_text: Civil Works Project Officer, Yarra City Council. Temporary Full Time until 16 April 2027. Band 5 from $80,410.06 + super + RDO. Supervise civil rectification works for development and subdivision sites; define and prepare scopes of reinstatement works on Council roads, footpaths and land; site assessments; coordinate contractors, developers and stakeholders; QA of reinstatement works; proactive and reactive inspections under the Road Management Plan, Local Law Permits and legislation. Experience in project delivery or a similar role within infrastructure or construction is highly desirable. Enquiries: Justin Cochrane, Team Leader Development and Civil Engineering, Justin.cochrane@yarracity.vic.gov.au. Resume and 1-page cover letter addressing KSC in the Position Description. Police Check required. Advertised 09 Nov 2026, closes 22 Nov 2026 11.55pm.
apply_instructions: Apply online via PageUp with resume and a 1-page cover letter addressing the Key Selection Criteria in the Position Description
